meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen's gradebook said zero, and nobody called me first.
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Go on.

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
He wrote it over the weekend and could have pasted it in. Did anyone ask him about these times before the zero went in?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Okay. A dated draft. Is anything on his record right now?
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Kids misquote Shakespeare from memory all the time. You still haven't told me whether anything is on his record.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Okay. It isn't close. What else do you have?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and a draft. Isn't that what revising is?

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Fine. I'll agree to the rewrite to put this behind him, not because he did anything. Private, nothing on his record, before December 1, and I want it in an email tonight, Hale.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
I'll confirm with Owen tonight. Put the date, the time and the room in the email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private, supervised rewrite for Owen on Thursday the twelfth after school, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still want that in writing, and I still want an answer on whether anything is on his record right now. I expect that email tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Last position: she accepted a private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth under 4.4, and she still wants it confirmed in writing, plus an answer on whether anything is on his record now; that is the fair outcome, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: You showed the Hamlet line that appears nowhere in the play and told her to search the scene herself, which gave her something she could check and answered her misquote defence.
What cost ground: You left her question about his record unanswered when she asked it, which kept her on her guard and kept her pressing.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its late-night edits the night before the essay was due, came very close to that night, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after showing the version history, answer her question about his record before she has to ask it a second time.
